translatorNotes: Register: informal tú, consistent with the rest of the Spanish site.

FLAG — real estate vocabulary varies between Spain and Latin America and should be checked by a native reviewer for the target market. Choices used here: brokerage -> agencia; agent -> agente; listing -> anuncio; portal -> portal; nurture sequences -> secuencias de cultivo; CRM hygiene -> higiene del CRM; phone agent -> agente telefónico; viewing -> visita; lead -> lead (kept as-is, common in Spanish marketing). In parts of LatAm 'inmobiliaria/corredora', 'propiedad/inmueble' and 'agendar' vs 'reservar' may read more naturally.
Acronyms kept as-is: CRM, SMS. IDX and ISA are in the general glossary to keep but do not appear literally in this post's body. If a reviewer introduces them, keep them as acronyms.

Currency: 'between $1,000 and $5,000' -> 'entre 1.000 y 5.000 dólares'. Stats kept exactly: 90 seconds -> 90 segundos, 4+ hours -> más de 4 horas, 34% -> 34%, 20+ hours -> más de 20 horas, 90 days -> 90 días, 30 minutes -> 30 minutos. Read time '6 min read' -> '6 min de lectura'. Date 'July 11, 2026' -> '11 de julio de 2026'.
Brand/legal names kept: Innovaria Tech Limited. Email info@innovariatech.space and phone +1 601 860 1258 unchanged.
